claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemComponentMechanics.ongoing_effect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item combines held passives with an activated planted aura that persists for 10 minutes and applies conditional benefits within an area. Current magic-item mechanics only allow passive, activation, triggered_reaction, or composites of those families.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Magic action, you can plant the haft end of the rod in the ground... While in that Bright Light, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class and saving throws...
